summary: The rounding implementation hardcodes the currency table instead of reading it from the contract; a new zero-decimal currency would round incorrectly without a contract change being reflected.

findings.note: round_amount duplicates the rounding-rule table locally instead of consuming the contract's table.
findings.reworkInstruction: Read the rounding-rule table from the quote contract; delete the local copy; add a test that a table-only contract change alters rounding behavior.
